summary: Captures the background and thinking from the LEMONADE working group, which was chartered to enhance Internet mail for diverse clients, such as mobile handhelds on limited links. It discusses needed protocol enhancements and design principles, with backward compatibility. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A history of why people wanted email to work better on small phones and slow connections, while still working with old email systems.
